title: You Cannot Pick a Provider From the Price List: Market-Aware Routing for Open-Weight LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2609.37902v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing LLM routers choose among models using static per-model costs. We show that open-weight inference markets introduce a second, largely ignored decision axis: after choosing a model, a client must still choose which provider serves it. Measuring live endpoints across [nummodels] open models, competing providers, multiple task types, and three measurement waves, we find that provider choice cannot be inferred from the price list. The same model can vary sharply in quality, latency, availability, and price across providers; higher-priced providers are consistently faster, but price does not reliably predict quality or availability; and provider feasibility is task-selective, with one deployment nearly normal on knowledge tasks but catastrophically degraded on multi-step reasoning. translated_title: 你无法从价目表中挑选供应商：面向开放权重LLM推理的市场感知路由
translated_abstract: 现有的LLM路由器使用静态的每模型成本在模型之间进行选择。我们展示了开放权重推理市场引入了第二个、在很大程度上被忽视的决策维度：在选择模型之后，客户端仍必须选择由哪个供应商来提供服务。通过对[nummodels]个开放模型、多个竞争供应商、多种任务类型以及三轮测量中的实时端点进行测量，我们发现供应商的选择无法从价目表中推断出来。同一模型在不同供应商之间的质量、延迟、可用性和价格可能差异巨大；价格较高的供应商通常更快，但价格并不能可靠地预测质量或可用性；供应商的可行性具有任务选择性，其中一个部署在知识型任务上表现接近正常，但在多步推理任务上却严重退化。我们将同模型供应商选择问题形式化为一个价格接受者的市场感知路由问题。一个简单的基于实测映射的策略可以路由到最便宜的可用供应商。
tldr: 论文揭示了开放权重LLM推理市场中同一模型在不同供应商间的质量、延迟、可用性和价格差异显著且无法从价目表推断，并将同模型供应商选择形式化为价格接受者的市场感知路由问题。
en_tdlr: Provider choice for open-weight LLM inference cannot be inferred from price lists, since the same model varies sharply in quality, latency, availability, and price across providers; this paper formalizes same-model provider selection as a price-taker market-aware routing problem.
